post.description:
To read a Google announcement or blog post someone linked from blog.google, such as a Gemini, Pixel, Search or Android launch post, a policy post or a country-edition post, or one section of it.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

max_chars.description:
Truncate `content` to this many characters; the full text is returned when omitted.

Provider reference: minimum 200; maximum 2000000.

section.description: Heading text or anchor (case-insensitive) whose subtree to return, e.g. `introducing-gemini` or `Sophisticated reasoning`.

url.description: Post URL on blog.google, e.g. https://blog.google/technology/ai/google-gemini-ai/ or https://blog.google/intl/de-de/produkte/suchen-entdecken/gemini-4/. A #anchor selects that section. Pattern: ^https?://.

200.description:
One blog.google post as clean Markdown: any article, short post or collection URL on blog.google, including /intl/{locale}/ editions and old URLs that redirect to the current section paths. Returns the canonical URL, page id, locale, type, title, description, subtitle, publication and modification times, authors (name, job title, author page), breadcrumbs, topic tags, hero image, an outline of headings (level, text, anchor) and the body with headings, lists, links, images with captions, YouTube and MP4 videos, related-content touts and footnotes. Pass `section` (heading text or anchor, case-insensitive) for one heading's subtree and `max_chars` to cap the content. Unknown posts and unknown sections are `not_found`; section, author, RSS and front pages are listings, rejected with the list_posts call to make instead.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `abstract` | string | Subtitle under the headline, when the post has one. |
| `authors` | object[] |  |
| `breadcrumbs` | object[] | Section path below the edition's front page; empty on some short posts. |
| `chars` | number | Characters before truncation. |
| `content` | string | Markdown of the post or the selected section. |
| `content_type` | string | article, short_post or collection. |
| `description` | string | Meta description. |
| `image` | string | Hero (og:image) URL. |
| `locale` | string |  |
| `modified` | string | Last modification time from the page's structured data. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number | Observation time, Unix milliseconds. |
| `outline` | object[] | Headings in order; empty for posts without headings. Footnotes appear as a final heading. |
| `page_id` | number | The site's page id (the same id list_posts reports). |
| `published` | string | Publication time, ISO 8601. |
| `section` | string | Text of the selected heading; null when the whole post is returned. |
| `tags` | object[] | 'Posted in' topics with their section URLs. |
| `title` | string |  |
| `truncated` | boolean |  |
| `url` | string | Canonical post URL after redirects. |

post.description:
To see what Google announced recently, or since a date, overall, in one product area or section (Gemini, AI, Search, Android, Security), by one author (Sundar Pichai, Demis Hassabis) or in one country edition, or when someone pastes a blog.google section, author, RSS or edition URL. Read posts with get_post.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

include_short_posts.description: Include short posts (brief announcements) alongside articles and collections. Default true.

limit.description:
Posts per page, default 20 (the API's maximum is 50).

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 50.

locale.description: Edition locale, e.g. en-us (default), de-de, fr-fr, ja-jp, en-in, es-419. Editions other than en-us live under https://blog.google/intl/{locale}/. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z]{2,3}(-[A-Za-z0-9]{2,4})?$.

page.description:
1-based page; use next_page from the previous call.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 10000.

section.description: A listing page on blog.google as a URL or path: a section (https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/products/gemini/, old paths such as /technology/ai/ or /threat-analysis-group/ follow their redirects), an author page (/authors/sundar-pichai/), an RSS feed (/rss/, /technology/ai/rss/) or an edition front page (/intl/en-in/). Its locale comes from the URL. Pattern: ^(https?://|/).

since.description: Only posts published on or after this day (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC). Pattern: ^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$.

until.description: Only posts published on or before this day (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC, inclusive). Pattern: ^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$.

200.description:
Latest posts from News from Google (blog.google), newest first, read from the listing JSON the site's own 'Load more' buttons call. Scope it to any listing page you have a URL for: a section (its feed's topic tags and site space are applied, for example Gemini, AI, Security), an author page (that author's posts), an RSS feed URL (its HTML page) or an edition front page, or name a locale edition. `since` and `until` bound the publication day, so 'what is new since X' is one call. Each post has its page id, URL, headline, summary, publication time, type (article, short_post, collection), authors with job titles, topics, word count and hero image. Pages of up to 50 posts; `next_page` continues.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `author_ids` | string | Author ids the page's feed requests (author pages); null otherwise. |
| `count` | number |  |
| `include_short_posts` | boolean |  |
| `limit` | number |  |
| `locale` | string |  |
| `next_page` | number |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number | Observation time, Unix milliseconds. |
| `page` | number |  |
| `posts` | object[] |  |
| `section` | string | Listing page URL after redirects; null for a whole edition. |
| `since` | string |  |
| `site_id` | number | The site's edition id (2 is en-us). |
| `sitespace_id` | string | Site space id the page's feed requests (for example 15 for Security); null otherwise. |
| `source_url` | string | The listing API request that answered. |
| `tags` | string | Comma-separated topic tag slugs the page's feed requests; null when it requests none. |
| `total` | number | Posts matching the scope and filters. |
| `until` | string |  |

To find a Google announcement when you know words from its headline or topic and roughly when it came out (for example 'Gemini 4 Argon' in October 2026, 'virtual power plant' this week), or to list a product's posts in a date range.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

include_short_posts.description: Include short posts (brief announcements) alongside articles and collections. Default true.

limit.description:
Stop scanning after the page where at least this many matches were found, default 20.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 50.

locale.description: Edition locale, e.g. en-us (default), de-de, fr-fr, ja-jp, en-in, es-419. Editions other than en-us live under https://blog.google/intl/{locale}/. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z]{2,3}(-[A-Za-z0-9]{2,4})?$.

page.description:
1-based listing page to start scanning from; use next_page from the previous call.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 10000.

q.description: Words that must all appear in a post's title, summary, URL, topic or author names, e.g. `Gemini 4 Argon`.

section.description: A listing page on blog.google as a URL or path: a section (https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/products/gemini/, old paths such as /technology/ai/ or /threat-analysis-group/ follow their redirects), an author page (/authors/sundar-pichai/), an RSS feed (/rss/, /technology/ai/rss/) or an edition front page (/intl/en-in/). Its locale comes from the URL. Pattern: ^(https?://|/).

since.description: Only posts published on or after this day (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC). Pattern: ^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$.

until.description: Only posts published on or before this day (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC, inclusive). Pattern: ^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$.

200.description:
Find blog.google posts by words in their title, summary, URL, topics or author names inside a publication window. The site's own search page is disallowed by robots.txt, so this scans the listing API newest first (up to 10 pages of 50 posts per call, bounded by `since`/`until` and optionally a section, author page or edition) and keeps posts matching every word of `q` (case ignored). Every hit has its URL, title, publication time, summary, type, authors and topics. `complete` says whether the whole window was scanned; when false, `next_page` continues. Narrow the window for older posts.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `complete` | boolean | True when every post in the window was checked. |
| `count` | number |  |
| `include_short_posts` | boolean |  |
| `locale` | string |  |
| `next_page` | number | Listing page to continue from when not complete. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number | Observation time, Unix milliseconds. |
| `page` | number |  |
| `q` | string |  |
| `results` | object[] |  |
| `scanned` | number | Posts this call checked. |
| `scanned_through` | string | Publication time of the oldest post checked. |
| `section` | string | Listing page URL after redirects; null for a whole edition. |
| `since` | string |  |
| `site_id` | number | The site's edition id (2 is en-us). |
| `source_url` | string | The first listing API request scanned. |
| `until` | string |  |
| `window_total` | number | Posts in the scope and window, as the listing API counts them. |
